family_reports.body: The system has deprive me of the opportunity to raise, love, and shape my daughter. The system has lied, destroyed, and robbed me of not only my daughter, but my entire relationship with my family.

System was complicit in alienating my children from me. Attorneys, GAL's, a Case Manager, Therapists, Judges, KVC. I have spent well over $150,000 over a two year period of time only to have two of my 3 children go no contact. No abuse, no drugs or addiction problems. All of this over screens and permissive parenting.

My family and life were ripped apart to keep USD 232 from consequences, and the lies told by multiple bad actors only impact me since there is no accountability for them.The only evidence available is the same evidence that would exonerate me but it would require unbiased court actors to look at it that way.
